about.title: Point Arena Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Point Arena is home to roughly 446 people, and a loss here is rarely a private matter for long. Neighbors on Main Street notice. The whole coast feels it. The most recent final crash year, 2020, recorded zero traffic deaths inside city limits, a count that reflects how small and quiet this stretch of Mendocino County is. Even so, wrongful death does not only happen on the road. It can follow a fall at a rental, a medical decision that went wrong, an unsafe worksite, or a collision on Rt 1 or Port Road involving a driver who was not paying attention. Under California law, a spouse or domestic partner and children hold the first right to bring a claim, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks considerably when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Point Arena families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless the case results in a recovery.

whyChoose.title: What a Wrongful Death Attorney Can Sort Out for Your Family

items.title: Who Is Allowed to File
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can identify every eligible family member so the claim is filed correctly the first time.

items.title: A Two-Year Clock That Can Be Shorter
items.desc: The general deadline runs two years from the date of death, but claims against a city, county, or state agency require notice much sooner. Getting connected early protects that window.

items.title: Losses the Law Actually Recognizes
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. A civil claim proceeds separately from any criminal case, so one does not have to wait on the other.

items.question: Point Arena had no traffic deaths in 2020. Does that mean a wrongful death case here is unlikely?
items.answer: Not at all. The 2020 count is simply a public-record figure for one year within city limits, and many losses that affect Point Arena families happen elsewhere in Mendocino County or have nothing to do with driving. Medical errors, unsafe property, and workplace incidents all fall under the same California wrongful death law. What matters is whether someone's negligence caused the death, not where it appears in a statistic.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, independent of any criminal prosecution. The two-year deadline keeps moving regardless of what happens in criminal court, so it is wise to speak with an attorney rather than wait for a verdict. In some situations the criminal case can even provide useful evidence for the civil claim.
